entries.title: Amos 2:1
segments: So says the LORD: For three transgressions of Moab, yea for four, I will not turn away [from] it; because he burned the bones of the king of Edom into lime.

entries.title: Amos 2:2
segments: But I will send a fire upon Moab, and it shall devour the palaces of Kerioth. And Moab shall die with great noise, with shouting, with the sound of a trumpet.

entries.title: Amos 2:3
segments: And I will cut off the judge from its midst, and will kill all its rulers with him, says the LORD.

entries.title: Amos 2:4
segments: So says the LORD: For three transgressions of Judah, yea for four, I will not turn away [from] it; because they have despised the laws of the LORD, and have not kept His commandments. And their lies after which their fathers walked led them astray.

entries.title: Amos 2:5
segments: But I will send a fire upon Judah, and it shall devour the palaces of Jerusalem.

entries.title: Amos 2:6
segments: So says the LORD: For three transgressions of Israel, yea for four, I will not turn away [from] it; because they sold the righteous for silver, and the poor for a pair of sandals;

entries.title: Amos 2:7
segments: panting after the dust of the earth on the head of the poor, and turning aside the way of the meek. And a man and his father will go [in] to the same woman, to defile My holy name.

entries.title: Amos 2:8
segments: And they will stretch beside every altar on garments taken in pledge, and they drink the wine of the condemned [in] the house of their god.

entries.title: Amos 2:9
segments: Yet I destroyed the Amorite before them, whose height [was] like the height of the cedars, and he [was] strong as the oaks; yet I destroyed his fruit from above and his roots from below.

entries.title: Amos 2:10
segments: Also I brought you up from the land of Egypt and led you forty years through the wilderness to possess the land of the Amorite.

entries.title: Amos 2:11
segments: And I raised up prophets from your sons and Nazarites from your young men. [Is it] not even so, O sons of Israel? says the LORD.

entries.title: Amos 2:12
segments: But you gave the Nazarites wine to drink, and commanded the prophets, saying, Do not prophesy.

entries.title: Amos 2:13
segments: Behold, I am pressed under you, as a cart full of sheaves [is] pressed.

entries.title: Amos 2:14
segments: And refuge shall perish from the swift, and the strong shall not strengthen his power, nor shall the mighty deliver his life;

entries.title: Amos 2:15
segments: nor shall he who handles the bow stand. And the swift-footed shall not save; and the horse rider shall not save his life.

entries.title: Amos 2:16
segments: And the stout-hearted among the mighty shall flee away naked in that day, says the LORD.
